prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1002; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear impact sustained while the vehicle was turning left, with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with a cervical strain. The mechanism and force of the collision align well with the injury described. Over the course of 27 visits, care included soft tissue treatment, range-of-motion exercises, and home stretching instructions. Progress followed a typical recovery pattern, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Examination documented reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal tenderness, supporting the diagnosis, while several neurological screening tests were within normal limits. The patient reported a remote, minor strain to the same region years earlier, which had resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
